```cypher
MATCH (p_customcert:Plugin {component: 'mod_customcert'})
WITH p_customcert.louvain_soc AS customcert_community
MATCH (p:Plugin)
WHERE p.louvain_soc = customcert_community
  AND p.component <> 'mod_customcert'
WITH p, customcert_community
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MAINTAINS]->(m:Maintainer)
WITH p, customcert_community, COLLECT(m) AS maintainers
WHERE SIZE(maintainers) = 1
  AND p.last_release_ts < (1790908800 - (3 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60))
RETURN p.component, p.name, [m IN maintainers | m.display_name] AS maintainer_names,
       datetime({epochSeconds: p.last_release_ts}).date AS last_release_date
ORDER BY p.name
LIMIT 100
```
